uncited: - **Assignment Map:** A mapping of processor IDs to their assigned time step indices.
**Assignment:** Assign time steps to processors in a round-robin or interleaved fashion.
**Rendering:** Each processor renders its assigned time steps sequentially.
**Sequencing:** A display system or sequencer picks frames from the pool in increasing time order.
**Loop:** Processors continue rendering their next assigned time step immediately after finishing the previous one.
- **Late Frames:** If a processor slows down, its assigned frame may arrive late.
The sequencer maintains a pool of frames; when a processor finishes a time step, it adds the image to the pool.
